MMM University of Technology Admission Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology Gorakhpur (MMMUT) has released the notification for the MMM University of Technology Admission 2026 B.Tech All Branches (Through JEE MAIN). The online application process for MMM University of Technology Admission Online Form 2026 has started on 27 May 2026, and candidates can apply till 20 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MMM University of Technology Admission Online Form 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 May 2026
  • Last Date : 20 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 June 2026
  • Last Date With Late Fess Payment : 20 July 2026
  • DV Date : 30 May to 22 June 2026
  • Choice Filling Date : 24 to 27 June 2026
  • Seat Allotment Date : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • All Category : Rs. 2500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
